title: Spectral Initialization and Certification for Power System Angle Estimation
summary: Power System State Estimation (PSSE) is commonly formulated as a nonconvex weighted least-squares (WLS) problem, making global optimality difficult both to attain and to certify. Recent work has shown that, when voltage magnitudes are known to sufficient accuracy, the remaining angle estimation subproblem can be reduced to phase synchronization and solved effectively using spectral initialization and spectral certification.
